reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: Awful, I paid for a carry-on bag, and because the wheel didn’t fit in their box, they charged an extra $40 dollars, unbelievable! This same bag fits in Latams box just fine. Their employees were also so rude, avoid this airline if you can.
reviews.author: Mechabrain

reviews.title: Disgusting Service – No customer service skills whatsoever
reviews.text: We wanted to purchase carry on bags online for $27 each but the website was not working. We went to the airport expecting them to assist us but the employee laughed and said it’s $40 each at the airport. We explained that the website didn’t work and we intended to purchase the carry on luggage at the airport but for the price listed online, however they refused to listen and did not give us the website price even though it isn’t our fault their site does not work. We were forced to pay $40 each for this 30 minute flight. All 3 of the staff we dealt with was disgusting, unreasonable, and treated us like cows. Horrible service, never again with Sky. For the rest of our trip we went with Avianca, Copa, Latam, and Aeroméxico — Sky was the worst by far. I experienced my 200th flight in my life on this trip and never have I seen such unacceptable service. Please avoid this airline. Thank you for the eye opener, Sky.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Everything about this airline is wrong
reviews.text: Worst airline ever!!!!!! All our flights were rescheduled to very inconvenient times, and when we tried to get a refund for our tickets (which we were entitled to according to the airline's policy), we only got refunded 14% of what we paid! Furthermore, the customer service through the website's chat is useless. Do not fly with them, it's not worth it. La peor aerolinea que hay!!!! Todos nuestros vuelos fueron reprogramados a unos horarios super inconveniences. Cuando solicitamos el reembolso de nuestros pasajes (a lo que teniamos derecho según el reglamento de la aerolinea), solo nos reembolsaron el 14% del total. Además, el servicio al cliente a través del chat en la pagina web es completamente inutil. Nunca vuelen con ellos, no vale la pena.
reviews.author: Guillermo R

reviews.title: Do not fly with Sky Air
reviews.text: I flew from Cusco to Lima. The staffs at the gate had me measure my carry on at their gate. My carry on was able to go through the slot but it got stuck from the handle that attached in the middle luggage. They made me pay $36 for a carry on that I already paid for!! They were so rude and mean and threaten not to let us board the flight if we don’t pay. I WILL NEVER IN MT LIFE TIME AGAIN FLY WITH THIS CHEAP AIRLINE!! They will try their best to squeeze every penny out of you anyway possible!!
reviews.author: yhconnie

reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: Do not fly Sky. We had an 8am flight to Cusco , waited 2 hours on the line and when we reached the counter we were told the flight had been delayed 5 hours but they could not guarantee we could fly. The employees were not even motivated to help the passengers, they did not even care to inform anyone doing the line that the flight was delayed. Their lack of empathy was even worse than the fact the flight was delayed. We never received an email or a text message informing us about the delay. We ended up buying new tickets with Latam.
reviews.author: Marta

reviews.title: We had no problems with this airline!
reviews.text: Despite all negative reviews for Sky Airline, we had no problems with them at all. We flew from Miami to Lima and back and both ways we had no issues. We booked the light fare and we had only one piece of luggage. They only looked at it to make sure we didn't have anything else and let us go without checking if it fit in their measurements. I assure you, the backpacks were slightly bigger then allowed and we were nervous, but they had no problem with that. The check in process was smooth both in Miami and in Lima. The flights on time. The service on the airplane is minimal, but that was to be expected. We were surprised that on the way back from Lima they did not allow us to bring any water bottles with us. Considering they don't give you free water on the plane it was disappointing, but they made it sound that it was the US policy and not theirs. Not sure about that. We also flew on domestic flight from Cusco to Lima and it went perfect. They check you in automatically. Also we had to make changes to our original flights and we did it all online without issues. Only thing was that they charged for price difference when I saw on the website that there wasn't any difference, but oh, what can you do. Overall we had good experience with Sky and would fly with them again.
reviews.author: zch2017

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service (except for Brenda!); overcharged for luggage, unable to get refund
reviews.text: Had to rebook a flight from Santiago, Chile to Puerto Natales, Chile due to a missed connection. Tried booking on the website, but kept timing out when I tried to submit payment, so I had to book it over the phone with the SKY reservations number. I was trying to book two Fare Plus tickets which includes one Carry-on bag per ticket. There was an extra charge for the checked bag. When I tried booking on the website, the total cost was $1095.30, but the customer service rep making my reservation for me said the total cost was $1267.64 because I needed to pay for the carry-ons. I kept insisting to him that I did not; we only had one carry-on and with the Fare Plus ticket there was no extra charge for that. But he kept saying "not exactly" and I was stuck because we needed to make this reservation, else our whole trip would have to be cancelled. So I paid it only to find out when we got our boarding passes that we now had "two carry-ons" approved for each traveler (we only had one!!!!) I immediatlely called Customer Service from the airport and requested this extra charge be reimbursed. The women I spoke with (Brenda) was very helpful and understanding and put a Case Number in for us. That was on 4/6/2023. It's now 4/28/2023 and this issue is still unresolved. Every time I call, I get the runaround, put on hold for 30 minutes plus, and finally told I will hear back in a couple days. Nothing. Today the guy told me I'd hear back in a couple of hours. I do not believe him. I do not think I will ever be reimbursed for this extra charge, but will try through my credit card company. Bottom line: Do no fly this airline! They are unethical.
reviews.author: Jane M

reviews.title: There’s a reason it’s called a low cost carrier
reviews.text: We booked a one way from Miami to Buenos Aires with layovers in Lima and Santiago. It took about an hour to check in because for whatever reason our trip showed as Destination Miami to Lima with a return flight from Lima to Santiago to Buenos Aires. Our bags somehow weren’t showing up even though I’m 99 percent sure I paid for them. We had a long layover in Peru and made sure that our checked bags continued on to the final destination and didn’t find their way to the carousel. We checked back in after our long layover and ensured with a gate attendant thst our bags were headed to Santiago. Again we checked with the flight attendant at Santiago since the bag ticket they gave us said final destination was Santiago (IDK). We were assured that it was headed to Buenos Aires. It never made it there somehow. We filed a claim and was told they’re probably in Santiago and we would hear back in 24 hours. I went ahead and filed a request on the website but never heard back from anyone even though it says if your flight is within 20 days they will contact you in 24 hours. I’m pretty sure the claim never got filed. After 28 hours We spent around 30 USD to take a taxi to the airport to try and find someone only to find out that not a soul from the airline was there. We then spent another 40 USD to take a taxi to another airport hoping we would find someone. I have talked to customer service and they said they don’t have any records of my bags. The chatbot thing doesn’t actually connect you to a human being it just says something like” request for information on your bags has been sent” then it repeats the process. I’m sitting on the floor of the airport at 10 pm waiting on someone to show up to talk to me to hopefully tell me they at least know what country my bags are in. We have a wedding in another country tomorrow. Save your money and spend more for a more reliable carrier.
reviews.author: matt d

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: Truly the worst airline. Avoid at all costs. Perpetual delays, mismanagement and incompetence personified.
reviews.author: Tom R

reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: Scoundrels, thieves. They charged us twice for the same flight, and now they refuse to refund the stolen money. The seat spacing is by far the worst of any airline that I have travelled on. Their approach to landing in Santiago was terrifying. Choose another airline.
reviews.author: James smith

reviews.title: SCAM! Avoid at all costs.
reviews.text: Flight was cancelled and they made it impossible to get my money back and it is impossible to contact them. Avoid at all costs!
reviews.author: zapatistaNYC

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: Absolute worst experience I have had with an airline. I am very much a budget traveler. I will sacrifice all of my comfort on a flight in order to get to a destination as cheaply as possible. Because of that, I have had to deal with some uncomfortable flight experiences. When backpacking through Chile I had a SKY flight get canceled because of COVID. Luckily they gave me a travel voucher. I tried to use it on my last trip from Lima to Miami. The voucher wouldn't work so I called customer service. The first agent I talked to had no idea how to help me. In order to get rid of me he just told me to create an account and call back if that didn't work. I tried that and it didn't work. I called back and waited on hold for over an hour. Finally, when someone picked up we ended up talking for an hour. At the end of my call, the agent basically told me that since I had bought the flight in Chile the only way I could use the voucher was if I bought another flight to Chile. The voucher expires in a month and I have no plans to go to Chile anytime soon. I tried for a while to see what I could do get my money back or at least apply it to the new flight I was booking. She kept telling me no and finally told me to clear my cache and try again. She hung up on me and I just didn't bother calling back and went with another airline, chalking my voucher up as a loss. If you're trying to save money there are better budget airlines. The hassle you have to put up with on SKY just isn't worth it.
reviews.author: Jacob F

reviews.title: Good people; terrible company
reviews.text: Terrible company: bought tickets about 12 days prior. paid and got confirmation. 5 days prior i added on additional luggage and upgraded seat. paypal cleared. then i can't log into their website to check in. the website states i still owe them money and have to pay again (i didn't). turns out this also happened to the person sitting next to me. showed up on the day of the flight - they said i don't exist and don't have a ticket at all. i waited at the counter and was the last one standing (almost missed the flight). the finally got my confirmation number and told me there was a computer glitch. Good people: the front desk lady was super cool and patient. she's definitely seen this movie play before so she assured me they'll clear me eventually. she called and texted her supervisor and was able to get me on the flight with an even better seat. because you have to pay for everything, the drinks services were fantastic. they're definitely working hard to sell stuff. they're also very aggressive picking up trash - i like it because it's a sign of efficiency to turn the plane over. this is the only company where the flight attendant quizzed me how to open the emergency door after asking me to read it. thumbs up. they really should do that more often at all airlines. bottom line - would avoid whenever possible.
reviews.author: coldfootwpulses

reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: They charges us twice for the same flight and they are resisting strongly to repay our money. This was a first and last flight on SKY AIRLINES. Never again. They appear to be novices. It seems to be a common practice of theirs, STEALING MONEY.
reviews.author: James smith

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: Rescheduled our flight without notifying us. Charged us to reschedule next day. Wasted a whole day of our trip dealing with them. Terrible
reviews.author: kevin a

reviews.title: Fees and Fees
reviews.text: Sky Airlines will do everything they can to charge you fees. I had 6 flights with them, on 5 of them my bag was able to go but on the 6th they would not let it fly without paying the fees. My bag actually became less full throughout the trip. It was clearly small enough to fit in the overhead bin as 5 other flights had agreed so, but some employees are stingy and will make you cough up money. My wifes bag is half an inch taller (not deeper) and she had to pay for each flight for a bag that clearly fit overhead. Clearly they are all about fees.
reviews.author: Rameez

reviews.title: Gianina Valencia and her unprofesional team who either don´t know international flight rights or simply ignoring them
reviews.text: Charged me for medical equipment which I have to carry because I am several disabled. Just because Gianina Valencia and her team didn´t like disabled people should not give them the right to discriminate them. A shame that such behavior still exists in the 21th century...
reviews.author: Jonas Wittmann

reviews.title: PANDERELLOS’ GANGSTERS
reviews.text: This outfit charged us twice for the same flight and they are resisting very strongly refunding the mis-appropriated funds.
reviews.author: James smith

reviews.title: Will not use them ever again
reviews.text: We have travel the world and we were never forced to check in our backpacks. This company made us do it and on top of that their website doesn’t work well so they don’t let you check in so they can charge you even more at the airport. $75 for checking in backup is outrageous! Also if you had any drink you bought on airport they will not let you take it on flight because they are just looking how to charge you more ! Not even water is free!!!!!
reviews.author: S C

reviews.title: Quick and easy fligh
reviews.text: Quick and easy flight. No problems at check in- plane was nice. 45 minutes flight from mendoza to santiago. Sky had the best schedule so tried them out. No complaints
reviews.author: David R

reviews.title: Solid budget airline
reviews.text: You get what you pay for. It was a solid trip - flight on time, bags arrived at baggage claim in less than 15mins. The planes are bare bones and all drinks and food cost extra, but crew was nice and boarding was organized. As long as you read the rules of the fares there should be no surprises.
reviews.author: Cara H

reviews.title: Worst experience with an agency
reviews.text: During my flight from Cincinnati to Cusco, Peru, I had tons of issues with this agency. To begin with, my flight to Cusco got cancelled and not even a refund has been given to me yet. Secondly, for my flight to Lima, they gave me a lot of trouble for my luggage. To begin with, they didn't accept my luggage and made me pay for it, the platform was insanely bad and I almost lost my flight because of that. Then after I paid for it, they told me they were going to take the luggage to cellar and here's where all my respect to the agency went to 0. They basically took my stuff and they threw it out like it was worthless. They came to damage chargers, ornaments and dolls that I was carrying, including gifts for my family. Regardless of whether you are carrying anything delicate or not, you should not take the confidence to destroy the passenger's things. Simple and simply terrible, I do not recommend it to anyone and I really ask you be careful because at any time they could have a very bad experience where in the end, the agency will not do anything to help you.
reviews.author: ItzSebas

reviews.title: Worst customer service ever
reviews.text: Worst customer service ever, after they lost my luggage it impossible to get information from the customer service. In the end they finally agreed for a refunding but then they made a mistake doing the wire transfer that got of course rejected. Now I keep asking them for an update on a new wire transfer but they just don't answer my message. 3 months since my luggage got lost and I am still waiting my refund. Stay away from this company
reviews.author: Renato R

reviews.title: The most unreliable airline
reviews.text: I wish I could give minus for the stars. Let’s start with how they didn’t send my reservations code until I send them an email 5 hours before my flight, and there is no confirmation or message about the flight being cancel. I arrived in the airport and saw them loading some peoples bags, so I believe the flight isn’t canceled. My bad that I ignored the red flag when I saw some cancel flight since the afternoon. I was waiting in the boarding room for 2 hours and 30 minutes before the flight they send me an email that the flight is canceled. I mean if you know you are going to cancel your flight just let people know a view hours in advance, so we can book in another reliable airline. And I know this is a cheap airline and never except anything about customer service but the lady just gave us a business card and said email here, email here. If you travel in budget just go with the bus, this airline is not worth your time and all the trouble it would gave you.
reviews.author: Arny L

reviews.title: Dreadful airline, avoid at all costs
reviews.text: Avoid this airline at all costs! The catalogue of poor service is astounding. COVID we had 2 flights cancelled totalling $360 and never got a refund. We put it down as an expected and acceptable loss after numerous emails went unanswered. We booked a flight that arrived at our destination at the most favourable time only to have them cancel that flight but then they wouldnt put is on alternative for free/easily as our original flight had a stop along the way. Ridiculous does not begin to describe that scenario - most airlines will do anything to accommodate you after a cancellation to stop you going to a competitor. They have cancelled yet another flight and we requested a refund as we were allowed to - told that we would have the money back in our accounts within 28 days and nothing has arrived 31 days later. Dreadful service!!!
reviews.author: T_Daly

reviews.title: Don't book with sky airline!
reviews.text: I booked the flight with hand luggage but at the check in they told us that we have to pay for it. In total we had 2 connecting flights with sky to get to our final destination. They couldn't even print both boarding passes and because it's a different booking.. but it's not! They just want us to pay 2 times for our bags. It's a big rip off with this airline and the service is bad.
reviews.author: Yolanda S

reviews.title: Not worth spending extra money
reviews.text: I had bought the STAR PASS (plus the seat in row 5) in order to skip the line early morning and to get into the plane first. Unfortunately there was no extra Staff for that Service and I had to wait for more than 25 minutes just as everybody else and actually was one of the last people entering the plane. When I asked why they would offer a Service they obviously don't provide I didn't get an answer. NEVER AGAIN!!!
reviews.author: Gabrielle

reviews.title: Do not use this airline
reviews.text: Terrible airline, changed my flight the night before I flew out from Cusco with no warning whatsoever. Customer service is non existent, clearly do not care about their customers I would strongly advise everyone to avoid this airline
reviews.author: Daniel B

reviews.title: Charged twice
reviews.text: Charged twice for the same flight. I doubt that I will fly on this airline again. They have charged me twice for the same flight, and I cant get them to change it because I cant contact them because they ask questions that I cant easily answer, like the ticket number or my RUT. But I don't have one. This trick of making it more or less impossible to contact them makes me very angry. I don't have time to spend trying to get my money back.
reviews.author: James smith

reviews.title: Good airline company
reviews.text: Nothing like the poor reviews I read online. My husband and I had a great experience flying with SKY airlines whilst in Peru. The flights were always on time and they even did the check in for us for free! Saving time and worries.
reviews.author: Veronica P

reviews.title: So much better than the horror stories I read
reviews.text: Travelled twice with Sky Airlines while travelling in South America. My wife and I worried about what we would be facing and panicked even more when we couldn't check in online but our bad experience ended there. The staff both at the airport's and on the flights were excellent. Our rucksacks were slightly bigger and heavier than their carry on limit but it wasn't an issue. Plane was a lot more comfortable than I was expecting and this is from someone who is tall. Flight boarding prompt and both flights left on time. Being Irish I have travelled with Ryanair many times and believe me Sky Airlines shouldn't be compared with them. They are easily better and i would say they are much better than easyJet too.
reviews.author: HailHail1888

reviews.title: A great experience travelling with Sky
reviews.text: After my two flights with Sky, and given the harsh reviews I read about the company, I felt under the obligation to write this positive review. I had not checked the reviews before I bought the tickets and was so worried when I read the reviews before my flight. The comments were appalling!! Well, MY experience was luckily the opposite. I had an impeccable experience with Sky in all aspects: check-in online and at the desk, checking the luggage, and the carry-on luggage (reading the reviews I was cautious with the sizes). The staff were helpful and nice all the time. The plane was punctual in both cases (round trip) and luckily there was no turbulence crossing the Andes. The seats were comfortable and of course, there was very little legroom, like any other Economy seat. I would definitely fly Sky again!
reviews.author: Monica T

reviews.title: AVOID! Rude, careless employees and terrible policies
reviews.text: Checking luggage at the airport (after checking in online) took over an hour because of so many issues. So we got to watch all the other customers around us have issues as well. Firstly, the staff is very rude to everyone. The employee helping us could not locate our tickets (my partner tried to explain that it was because she was spelling his name wrong), she did not listen, and then that he had only purchased one ticket, once again because she was not looking at the correct customer but she would not listen to us. Then we were told he had purchased tickets for the wrong date and asked to get out of line, even though we had our digital boarding passes and had been able to check in online. As we are panicking and looking to buy a 2nd set of tickets, he thankfully triple checks and we clearly did not so we got back in line. This time, we argued more strongly and they still had trouble locating and asked us to pay luggage fees, even though we had already done so online when we checked in, apparently this does not update in their system. So we argued again and found proof on our phones in our banking account that we had paid them the fee already. They then had to update the entire system on their computer so that it would reflect this so we had to wait until that was finished to continue checking in. We had arrived at the airport 2 hours before our flight (the recommended amount of time) and we were nearing boarding time at this point. People all around us were having many issues, mainly with luggage requirements. They are extremely, crazy strict about size and shape of personal items and carry on baggage. To the point of ridiculousness. If ANY amount (even the smallest bit) or your bag was above the bin when you put it in, you were asked to check. Even after one girl unpacked her entire bag and made it work, they still forced her to check her bag, without explaining why. I fly often and I have never seen an airline with such ridiculous restrictions and staff attitude about the entire check in process. We nearly bought a second set of airline tickets because of them and could have easily missed our flight or our luggage not make it on the plane because it took so long to check our baggage. I will never fly with them again and I suggest you find an alternative if you can. It may not sound like a huge deal but it’s not worth the headache or extra fees and they do not care about their customers at all. I can’t imagine how they’d treat you if you had an actual issue like lost baggage or cancelled flight. AVOID!!!!
reviews.author: Brittany E

reviews.title: Companhia aérea péssima / Awful  airline
reviews.text: Companhia aérea péssima / Awful airline Aeronave velha/comissários péssimos - não voo com essa companhia aérea Sky nunca mais Old aircraft/bad flight attendants - will not fly with this Sky airline ever again
reviews.author: Sergio S

reviews.title: They sold my flight and make my loss a conference that cost me thousands of dollars and months of work
reviews.text: I was unable to do my online check in because of problema with their app. When i arrived to the airport they told me that in was an standby passenger i lost my flight. I had was unable to be presente at a conference with a research that cost me months of work and thounsands of dollars. Beware with thia airline ifnyou need to follow a precise schedule.
reviews.author: camilo ferreira

reviews.title: Positive review
reviews.text: My experience was excellent. I made an error in my name spelling but didn't realize it until after I purchased. I wrote them and email and received a personal response same day with the fix. After that, always super polite, very good to excellent service. zero issues. We used again and have flight set in a couple of days. So far the purchase and communication has been excellent, boarding pass waiting for us. Better service and experience than the larger, and more expensive Latam airlines for example.
reviews.author: Alan K

reviews.title: If I could give a zero, I would
reviews.text: Honestly, my worst flight ever. The flight attendant was incredibly rude. We were 2.5 hours delayed while sitting on the plane. No water offered. No toilets allowed. The overhead compartments opened while taking off and landing. The remain seated light stayed on the entire time so in total, close to 4 hours without a toilet. I tried once because we were at cruising altitude and there was no turbulence and the flight attendent refused to let me. Take your worst spirit and Ryan air experience, combine it, and then welcome yourself to sky airlines. FYI, SCREAMING toddlers were running up and down the aisle. Not happy screams. Angry. Very angry. Really took the attitude of the people flying and vocalized it while making us even more miserable than we already were.
reviews.author: Cleo P

reviews.title: The worst flight experience I've ever had
reviews.text: Terrible service to purchase the ticket, to check in, flight and even to buy extras... Se você é brasileiro, saiba que os voos dessa companhia não oferece malas de mão. ----------------------------‐---
reviews.author: Mateus L

reviews.title: Awesome airline, great service, super cheap
reviews.text: We flew SKY from Lima to Cusco and were worried because it’s a discount airline and has some bad reviews. However you should absolutely go with SKY!! They were way cheaper than Latam and everything was fast and quick. You can pay for priority boarding for 2 dollars and sure baggage is more, but way cheaper than Latam. We saved over 150 dollars each by going with sky and would definitely fly with them (at least from Lima) again!
reviews.author: Blake H

reviews.title: Worst company!!!!
reviews.text: Worst company ever! Telling different sizes of the hand luggage than on the airport (had to pay because of these 2cm they declared wrong) than they didn't accept my dollar because there was a crack of 2mm like on every normal dollar note!!! Horrible service! Never again!!!!!
reviews.author: Lisa S

reviews.title: Laughing at these negative review- Liars!
reviews.text: I was baffled on the number of bad reviews this airline got. From cancelations, to being non-friendly to foreigners. I read it all and myself was skeptical. However when I came to the airport. Everything was completely reversed. I had THE BEST SERVICE. The website was super easy to navigate, I got the STAR PASS which was only a few bucks and a lifesaver- ( who wants to wait in line anyway?) I also paid for one luggage to be checked in. It was easy to check in online, and when I decided to check in a bag, STAR PASS gave me that vip treatment. I would even go about talking about how much they listened to my needs. I saw no discrimination as a foreigner nor saw any of that to the other passengers. The plane was clean and the service there was wonderful. Everyone was smiling and pilots were friendly as well. I didn't understand why i read so many bad reviews... I would assume that people just book cheap and expect to be treated like a king. Everything is in english for non spanish speaking individuals like myself. The airline was prompt even on their customer service end. They made a changed that I suggested within a hour, which was super fast! I loved sky I will use them again! don't believe those hate reviews. I have flown many times around the world and SKY airlines delivers! great job!
reviews.author: hiddenblackmask

reviews.title: TERRIBLE AIRLINE
reviews.text: So, let's say, you buy a water bottle right before you fly your plane. Then you see that there is an actual security line (after security, let me specify, by the way, right before boarding) that checks to see if you are carrying a water bottle with you. So guess what? Potential lawsuit--let's say you have an emergency / medical condition wherein you need to drink water? They did not even offer any water at any time during this flight. Before this, we had a wonderful fight with the check-in person who told us that our Kiwi reservation was a scam / not affiliated with this airline. So I had to pay for my luggage even though it said it was already included on my Kiwi receipt. Spent an hour fighting with this woman. New rules were implemented at every check-in point. Don't waste your money or time on this airline.
reviews.author: Clayre B

reviews.title: I’d rather walk
reviews.text: Quite possibly the worst airline in the world. Pay the extra $ and fly with a more reputable airline. You get what you pay for and it’s better to know that before you decide to book with them versus after you do when it’s too late and your drowning in incompetence and “I don’t know”s.
reviews.author: Trey

reviews.title: SKY TOURS IS A SCAM - DO NOT BOOK WITH THEM UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES
reviews.text: Trip Advisor, you NEED to stop associating yourselves with this scam of a company. I have my Masters in Journalism and work for a news publication company. I have zero issues with taking this issue to the media if this is not resolved immediately. I was quoted "up to 6 months" for this refund. It is over the 6 month mark. All your reviews online are absolutely horrible and people are still waiting on refunds 18+ months after cancellation. "Your refund is in process" is not an acceptable answer for me at this point. We have flight insurance, your company already knows how much you need to send back to me. Delaying taking the 2 minutes to make a transfer to my bank account is taking my frustration with your company to another level beyond already telling everyone I know to never use this company again. I want a date sometime this month that my refund will be coming through or I will be submitting this story to be publicized. Also, before you attempt to give my a flight credit as my refund, I will not accept that as I am legally entitled to a monetary refund, as your policy states.
reviews.author: Emily J

reviews.title: Uneventful Flight
reviews.text: We were nervous about this flight after reading the less than stellar airline reviews, so I want to leave a non-complaining review to relieve other travelers' fears. We wanted to get to Cusco without spending the night in Lima so we could start getting acclimated to the altitude for our trek. Sky offered the latest flight at 7:30pm which gave us the longest connection with our 5:18pm arrival from the US. Two hours was enough time to clear customs, check our bags, and go back through security. We had almost an hour to wander around the terminal before boarding, unfortunately the only lounge for domestic flights closes at 4pm. The flight boarded in an organized manner. The seats weren't that comfortable, but fine for a short flight. Our luggage was delivered within 20 minutes of landing in Cusco. Overall uneventful, as flying should be!
reviews.author: Charlie0326

reviews.title: Broken systems and no chance of a refund
reviews.text: Be careful what you pay for! I paid for extra legroom on two flights and didn't receive it. No chance of a refund Apparently if you don't check in online they just give your seats away
reviews.author: Max N

reviews.title: They helped us a lot.
reviews.text: When my wife and I missed the flight over confusion with the flight time (didn't say am or pm the ticket time) , they let us reschedule just this once so that we can get back to our country by Monday. The customer service and the supervisor were excellent! They help us out in all we needed it, God bless u!
reviews.author: Chris S

reviews.title: Does not refund money, not trustworthy
reviews.text: Unfortunately I have to join the many complaints about Sky Airlines. We booked 3 flights with Sky in Peru. For the mentioned flight from Cusco to Lima they shifted the flight time and made it impossible for us to get our connection flight in Lima. We had to book a new flight with another company yo get to Lima in time. The offered, booking another date, flight voucher or refund. I opted for refund, filled several forms over and over again but nothing ever happened. I meanwhile realized I won’t see my money again. Our other flights with them went well, but the company is not trustworthy to me anymore and I will never consider to book a flight with them again.
reviews.author: SPeter55

reviews.title: Cusco to Lima
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible company. Took them an hour (45min after we were suppose to take off) to board the plane. Literally one row at a time with ZERO sense of urgency. Tons of people getting anxious seeing almost everyone had connecting flights! If I can avoid Sky airlines at all cost I’d pay more and sacrifice time to avoid this airline.
reviews.author: Kenneth R

reviews.title: As bad as it can be
reviews.text: Staff is negligent to help users in general, didn’t happen to me but I could see many disappointing situations. Aircrafts are just okay, not very clean tbh and leg room as small as possible… all of this is understandable from a cheap airline but staff being rude and not being helpful to customers in very simple situations is definitely a red flag. Don’t recommend it and will avoid using it at all times
reviews.author: federico gonzalez
